children: , the networking and security company, announced a multiyear deal to upgrade Notre Dame's campus network. Shares slipped about 0.3% to $106.12 Wednesday morning. The university is preparing its network for more connected devices and heavier demands from research and AI applications.

This is a substantial equipment rollout: nearly 1,000 Catalyst 9300X switches across the South Bend campus. Cisco says Catalyst Center will manage configuration, ThousandEyes will help monitor network performance, and its Professional Services team will provide support throughout the partnership.

For investors, the appeal is the package around the switches: software, monitoring and services that can keep Cisco involved after installation. The image puts the shares 42.08% above their $74.69 GF Value estimate, a reminder that expectations are already high. Cisco disclosed the deployment's scale, but gave no contract value or expected profit contribution.

title: Cisco Slips 0.3% as 1,000 Switches Build an AI-Ready Campus
